experiment_name: Upfront fee transparency on the offer screen
hypothesis: Showing an itemised fee breakdown before acceptance raises offer acceptance (approved -> disbursed) by >= 3pp.
A one-tap autopay prompt on the disbursal screen raises autopay enablement by >= 8pp and improves on-time first EMI.

experiment_name: Onboarding redesign: trust signals + progress indicator
hypothesis: Adding security/trust signals (regulated-lender badge, encryption note, DigiLocker one-tap) and a 3-step progress bar raises 7-day KYC completion among new app signups by >= 4pp (MDE sized to 6 weeks of app traffic).
